stories.headline: MKBHD Announces Fresh Start with New Video “I’m Starting Over”
stories.summary: Tech YouTuber Marques Brownlee (MKBHD) posted a video titled “I’m Starting Over,” signaling a shift in his content strategy. He hints at revamping his channel’s approach, though details of the changes remain limited in the release.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Drops Model-Driven Predictions for Nuggets vs. Mavericks NBA Cup Clash
stories.summary: CBS Sports has released analytical predictions, betting odds, and start times for the upcoming 2026 NBA Cup matchup between the Denver Nuggets and Dallas Mavericks. The breakdown uses a proven data model to guide bettors on the November 24 showdown. Fans and gamblers can consult the site for specific game insights.

stories.headline: Review: Kevin DeYoung’s ‘Church History for Everyone’ Makes the Past Accessible
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition essay evaluates DeYoung’s latest work, arguing that a clear, narrative‑driven approach to church history can equip modern believers with essential context for today’s challenges.

stories.headline: TGC Explores Integrating Church History Into Modern Ministry
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition released resources detailing how pastors and leaders can utilize historical church movements to shape contemporary ministry. The essay series addresses traditional theology and foundational figures to guide modern evangelicals. Authors emphasize the value of looking to past church eras to address current spiritual challenges.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Follows Up on Editorial Trust and Integrity
stories.summary: Popular tech creator Marques Brownlee has published the second installment in a series examining whether audiences can trust his product assessments. The release addresses channel credibility and transparency standards across his gadget coverage and review processes.

stories.headline: GPT‑6.2 Astra Identifies 1808 Sketchbook’s Creator in 22 Minutes
stories.summary: Using minimal prompts, the new Astra model traced an anonymous Yale sketchbook to the vicomte de Chabot by uncovering a little‑known diary reference and recommending a Cleveland State University journal for confirmation. The discovery also yielded a previously unknown source valuable to Canadian and fur‑trade historians.

stories.headline: MKBHD Reviews MacBook Pro LED: Stellar Performance, Not Just Looks
stories.summary: MKBHD calls the new MacBook Pro LED an “incredible laptop,” praising its speed and display while warning viewers not to get distracted by superficial features. The review emphasizes real-world productivity gains over aesthetic hype.

stories.headline: MKBHD Deploys Holiday Tech Guide Highlighting Budget Gear Under $50
stories.summary: Popular tech creator MKBHD published his annual holiday gift guide featuring top-tier gadgets priced under $50. The curation targets affordable tech options suitable for holiday shoppers looking for quality electronics on a budget. The accompanying video details specific hardware picks.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Ranks His Favorite Halloween Candy
stories.summary: In a light‑hearted video, Marques Brownlee (Marques Blind) shares his personal ranking of Halloween treats, offering quick commentary on taste, texture, and nostalgic appeal.

stories.headline: Marques’ Studio Spotlights Obscure Foldable Phones
stories.summary: The Studio episode features Marques highlighting a selection of lesser‑known foldable smartphones, explaining their unique designs and why they’ve flown under the mainstream radar.

stories.headline: Preaching Strategies Tailored for Modern Workers
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition published guidelines focusing on how faith leaders can effectively communicate spiritual concepts to working-class congregations. The material addresses the disconnect between traditional sermons and daily secular employment. Pastors are encouraged to ground their messages in the realities of daily vocations.

stories.headline: Scoring Cuts Won't Fix the Wizards
stories.summary: Asking Trae Young to reduce his scoring output is merely a superficial bandage for the Washington Wizards. The team faces deeper, self-inflicted roster issues that require structural roster solutions rather than tactical adjustments from their star guard.

stories.headline: Rams vs. Packers Thanksgiving Eve Predictions
stories.summary: A proven predictive model has released its picks, odds, and game analysis for the upcoming NFL Thanksgiving Eve matchup between the Rams and Packers. Bettors are using these data-driven insights to evaluate the spread and total before kickoff.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence Newsletter Breaks Down Rookie Rankings and NBA Surprises
stories.summary: The November 24, 2026 edition of Basketball Intelligence covers a wide array of league storylines, including rookie rankings and defensive standouts. Key pieces examine the NBA Misery Index, early draft regrets, and recent game performances across the league. Subscribers get access to extensive team-specific deep dives.

stories.headline: The Individual Exception: How AI Lets One Person Do the Work of Whole Teams
stories.summary: Ben Thompson details his solo creation of a full studio control system, custom iOS tools and a distributed computing harness, all built with AI assistance. He then contrasts this with historical data showing employee counts at giants like AT&T and IBM have plummeted even as revenue and market cap have surged.

stories.headline: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months
Chinese AI Lab Z.ai Launches GLM-5.4 Featuring Loop Transformer Architecture
stories.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first model utilizing a looped transformer architecture that reuses weight-shared layers for multiple iterations. This design increases network depth without raising the overall parameter count, aiming to enhance complex reasoning tasks like agentic coding.

stories.headline: PrismML Launches Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B for Local Agentic Coding
stories.summary: PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an upgraded open-weight model based on Qwen 3.8 that enhances local multi-turn tool use and agentic workflows. Retaining a compact 5.9 GB memory footprint, the model drastically improves generation speed and reduces repetitive loops on consumer hardware like the RTX 4090. Benchmarks show it significantly narrows the performance gap against full-precision base models.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Announces 2026 Book Award Finalists
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition released its annual selections for the 2026 Book Awards, highlighting prominent Christian literature across various categories. The featured list includes essential theological essays, commentaries, and historical studies aimed at church leaders and believers. These selections showcase influential works addressing faith, ministry, and spiritual practice over the past year.

stories.headline: TraTraTrax Drops Weird Baile Rips
stories.summary: Colombia's TraTraTrax label has released Collected Rips 2004-2024, a 14-track archival compilation of unreleased music from Brazilian underground producers. Painstakingly mastered from low-quality MP3s and voice notes, the record captures the dark, glitchy origins of online baile funk.

stories.headline: Leaked Data Reveals Heavy Russian Casualties
stories.summary: Leaked Rosstat mortality data analyzed by the BBC indicates that nearly 490,000 Russian soldiers have died since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The figures show that the conflict has drastically skewed domestic mortality rates, heavily impacting young Russian men.

stories.headline: Leaks Indicate Upcoming iPhone 18e Will Feature a Redesigned Camera Plateau
stories.summary: New CAD leaks suggest Apple is bringing a square camera bump to the upcoming budget-friendly iPhone 18e, breaking away from its flush-lens design. Meanwhile, the base iPhone 18 is expected to sport a thicker camera module housing potential hardware upgrades, while the ultra-thin iPhone Air 2 will finally add a second rear camera. These devices are slated for a spring release as part of Apple's phased launch strategy.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Headquarters to Enthusiastic Employee Cheers
stories.summary: Jensen Huang was welcomed back to Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters by a massive crowd of cheering employees just days after his abrupt departure. Huang apologized for the turmoil and promised to be a better CEO during his second stint leading the tech giant.

stories.headline: ‘Help! My Bible Reading Feels Dead’ – A Call to Revitalize Personal Study
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition piece addresses the common sense of stagnation in daily Scripture reading and offers practical steps to restore engagement and spiritual vitality.

stories.headline: Steelers Bench Aaron Rodgers for Mason Rudolph
stories.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers have made the dramatic decision to bench Aaron Rodgers and start Mason Rudolph against the Broncos. This move raises serious questions about the veteran quarterback's future with the franchise as the season progresses.

stories.headline: Micah Parsons Cleared for Season Debut
stories.summary: Dallas Cowboys star Micah Parsons has officially been cleared to make his long-awaited season debut ahead of the Thanksgiving slate. Meanwhile, running back Kenneth Walker III returned to practice as teams finalize their injury reports for the holiday games.

stories.headline: LLMs Rank Top Open Math Problems
stories.summary: ProofAtlas has published a ranking of 500 open mathematical problems evaluated by their perceived importance using a consensus model of leading LLMs. The system pairs problems to judge historical fame, cross-field reach, and scholarly impact across multiple AI families.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Serves Up DFS Lineup Strategy for Rams-Packers Thanksgiving Eve Clash
stories.summary: CBS Sports has published daily fantasy football picks and lineup advice for the Rams versus Packers matchup on Thanksgiving Eve. The coverage provides DFS players with strategic roster recommendations to maximize points in holiday contests. Analysts break down key player matchups to target for the prime-time slate.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Projects Latest 12-Team College Football Playoff Bracket
stories.summary: CBS Sports has updated its projected 12-team College Football Playoff bracket following the release of the fourth 2026 CFP rankings. The breakdown illustrates how the current top contenders would shake out in the postseason tournament field. Analysts map out the bubble teams and projected conference champions as the regular season winds down.

stories.headline: Emma Ogier Delivers Compelling Debut Album 'Fly 1111'
stories.summary: Houston singer-songwriter Emma Ogier blends country twang, pop hooks, and indie sensibilities on her debut album, Fly 1111. Released via Lost Highway, the record balances youthful rebellion with sharp, mature storytelling.

stories.headline: Datasette-Charts 0.2a0 Adds Direct Integration with Datasette Agent
stories.summary: The latest update to the datasette-charts plugin introduces integration with Datasette Agent, allowing users to generate charts simply through chat prompts. Users can seamlessly view, build, and interact with data visualizers directly inside their browser windows.

stories.headline: Datasette-Agent 0.7a1 Released With Enhanced Fragment Hash Navigation
stories.summary: The latest pre-release of Datasette Agent improves chat session side panels by supporting navigation via fragment hashes. This update ensures smoother integration with companion plugins like datasette-charts.

stories.headline: OpenAI Preprint Claims Matrix Multiplication Exponent Bound of O(n^2.25)
stories.summary: A newly published OpenAI math preprint details research claiming a tighter bound for matrix multiplication efficiency. The paper, shared via GitHub, explores reducing the computational complexity exponent to nine-fourths. The academic drop has drawn attention from mathematicians and computer scientists analyzing the theoretical advance.

stories.headline: Font’s ‘American Bully XL’ Marries Country Heartbreak with Industrial Noise
stories.summary: Texas post‑punk quartet Font’s sophomore album abandons the cryptic swagger of 2024’s Strange Burden for raw, confessional songwriting. The record fuses classic country melancholy with snarling synths, sax and a noise box, pushing Thom Waddill’s ragged vocals through layers of distortion while still delivering moments of tenderness.

stories.headline: Finding Comfort in Christmas Amid Heavy News
stories.summary: For those fatigued by a relentless and exhausting news cycle, the Christmas season offers a welcoming anchor of enduring hope. The narrative of the holiday provides spiritual relief and a reminder of grace for a weary public.

stories.headline: Huawei Guilty of Trade Secret Theft
stories.summary: A Brooklyn federal jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei on 10 counts, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud, following a two-month trial. However, the jury acquitted the company of the more severe overarching racketeering charge.

stories.headline: Ramaphosa Wins South African Court Battle
stories.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa successfully overturned an independent panel report that alleged misconduct regarding a major theft at his Phala Phala game farm. The Western Cape high court declared the panel's findings unlawful, effectively halting current parliamentary impeachment proceedings.

stories.headline: Washington Apple Growers Face Financial Crisis
stories.summary: Washington’s $9 billion apple industry is struggling under the weight of high labor, fuel, and fertilizer costs. Farmers are increasingly abandoning orchards as tariffs and a strong dollar erode export competitiveness, making it cheaper to clear land than to maintain it.

stories.headline: U.S. Probes Potential Iranian Cyberattacks on Shipping
stories.summary: Federal officials are investigating reports that up to 50 commercial vessels have been compromised by cyberattacks. Intelligence suggests the breaches may be linked to Iran, marking a potential escalation in cyber warfare against global infrastructure.

stories.headline: EA Sports FC 27 Reanimates John Motson via AI
stories.summary: Electronic Arts has used generative AI and archival audio to recreate the voice of legendary commentator John Motson for its latest football game. The project, which marks the first time the series has featured a deceased commentator, was developed with the full consent and participation of Motson’s family.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands Ditches China for Security Pact with Australia
stories.summary: The Solomon Islands has signed a new security and economic treaty with Australia, effectively ending a controversial 2022 security deal with Beijing. The move signals a major strategic pivot for the Pacific nation, aiming to restore regional stability and strengthen ties with Canberra.

stories.headline: Millwall Hit With Partial Stadium Closure and Fine Over Chants
stories.summary: Millwall has been ordered to partially close sections of The Den and pay a £70,000 fine after fans engaged in ableist and homophobic chanting during a January match against Charlton Athletic. The independent regulatory commission imposed the strict sanctions due to the club's poor disciplinary history regarding discriminatory fan behavior. Blocks within the Dockers Stand will be closed for the upcoming fixture against Sheffield United.

stories.headline: Finalist Brings Paper‑Style Daily Planner to iPhone Duo
stories.summary: Finalist, a four‑year‑old planning app, launches a dedicated iPhone Duo version that mimics a notebook layout across the dual screens, showing sunrise, moon phase, agenda, timeline and a desk‑clock. Users can drag tasks, customize sections, and rely on on‑device AI to suggest times, delivering a paper‑feel with digital conveniences.

stories.headline: Versine Launches YC-Backed MCP Allowing AI Agents to Handle Money Transfers
stories.summary: Y Combinator startup Versine has launched a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that lets users send and request money simply by talking or texting with their AI assistant. Built on self-custodial USDC stablecoin wallets on Base to bypass fiat regulatory hurdles, the tool handles splitting bills and group expenses. Users maintain security by approving transactions via passkeys while granting agents controlled access to funds.

stories.headline: Nvidia Shares Slip 8% After Lawmakers Question Trump’s Role in CEO Return
stories.summary: Nvidia’s stock fell nearly 8% on Tuesday amid bipartisan scrutiny of President Trump’s claim that he persuaded the board to reinstate Jensen Huang following his resignation over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The dip came despite a prior surge, while rivals AMD, Broadcom and Marvell also slipped amid broader AI‑sector concerns.

stories.headline: Bellingham Shines in Real Madrid Win
stories.summary: Jude Bellingham scored a stunning volley to help Real Madrid secure a 5-1 victory over PSV after coming off the bench. Despite manager Jose Mourinho calling him the world's best midfielder, the 23-year-old humbly dismissed comparisons to his idol, Zinedine Zidane.

stories.headline: Trump Profits Millions Following Nvidia CEO Reinstatement
stories.summary: Donald Trump reportedly gained up to $15 million in Nvidia stock value after intervening to help reinstate CEO Jensen Huang. Huang had been ousted by the board following allegations of multiple affairs, but returned to the company after Trump claimed to have brokered the deal.

stories.headline: The Rise of Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
stories.summary: Once a skeptical pick for the Trump administration, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has emerged as a central and highly influential figure in the White House. The former George Soros money manager is now being discussed by insiders as a potential top-tier contender for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination.

stories.headline: Texas and Notre Dame Enter College Football Playoff Top Four
stories.summary: The latest College Football Playoff rankings feature a shake-up as Texas and Notre Dame break into the top four. Additionally, Tennessee has climbed the rankings, successfully leapfrogging Alabama in the latest poll.

stories.headline: Restoring a 1982 Japanese ‘Star Wars’ Poster: A Digital Revival
stories.summary: The feature details the meticulous process of rescuing a rare 1982 ‘Star Wars’ movie poster sourced from Japan, using high‑resolution scanning and color correction techniques to bring the vintage artwork back to its original vibrancy for collectors.
